text:
kim: Kicking off embed-service canary in eu-west — rolling plan 10% -> 50% -> 100%. Please watch p95, error rate, and KV cache latency. Tagging @oncall and @sre-bot.

deploy-bot: [deploy] embed-service v1.4.0 -> starting canary (10%) in eu-west. tasks: healthchecks, traffic-shift, autoscale monitor. id=deploy-1725012345

mike: On it. Opening the SLO dashboard now (p95 / 5xx / kvcache). Will call if anything flares. :eyes:

jess: quick note — synthetic probe shows eu-west embed p95 +9% vs baseline after warmup. Not yet 5xx but latency tail creeping. dashboard: https://dash.redwood/s/eu-west/embed/slo

mike: can you paste the last 15m graph or a gif? hard to see from mobile.

jess: Paste below (snip):
```
15m p95: baseline 210ms -> now 230ms (spike at +28ms pinned to kvcache miss rate)
5xx: 0.03%
qps: canary 38 rps
```

kim: thanks. if p95 > +12% or 5xx > 0.5% we pin back to v1.3.2 and pause rollout. command if needed: `deploy-bot pin-version embed-service v1.3.2 --reason "canary p95 regression"`

sre-bot: alert: autoscaler added 2 pods to embed-service-eu-west (scale up triggered by queue latency).

deploy-bot: canary at 10% -> healthchecks passing (http 200). continuing monitoring.

jess: did a manual KV cache flush on the canary nodes; p95 dipped to +4% now.
mike: nice. recommend hold 10% for one more window (5m) then shift to 50% if stable.

kim: agree — hold 5m. if any 5xx or p95 trend up again we abort and roll back.

sre-bot: monitoring rule: `eu-west.embed.5xx_rate` crossed 0.5% threshold -> current 0.72% (aggregated over 3m). HOLD and notify execs.

deploy-bot: canary traffic paused at 10% due to SRE hold (rule: eu-west.embed.5xx_rate). backoff timers engaged.

mike: oncall pinged, starting quick triage. Looks like a dependency upstream returning 502 intermittently — correlating traces now.

jess: trace snippet: `embed->kvcache GET latency 210ms; upstream auth 502 spikes at t=+8s` — pushing a temporary routing rule to retry upstream once.

kim: decision: keep canary paused. do NOT promote. We'll pin to v1.3.2 for EU if we can't stabilize in 15m. I'm creating a rollback pin ticket.
mike: logging the rollback ticket and notifying PMs. If retry reduces 5xx under 0.3% within 10m we can re-evaluate.

jess: status update in 8m. thanks all. :thumbsup:
